verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE, so inline completions are a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence only documents chat-driven agent edits with inline diff review. Nothing describes as-you-type completions or next-edit suggestions, and diff review of agent edits is an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
